A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you drop by.

Which phone brands do you sell?+

We sell OPPO, HONOR, Infinix, realme, vivo, Redmi, Samsung, and iPhone. Ask in store for our current models and availability.

Can I buy a phone through this website?+

This website helps you explore our brands and find our shop. Purchases, current pricing, and stock enquiries are handled in store.

Do you sell phone accessories?+

Yes. Visit us to explore phone cases, screen protectors, earbuds, chargers, cables, and other phone accessories. Product selection varies.

Where are you, and when are you open?+

You’ll find Ether Technology Sdn Bhd at Lot 2-27, 2nd Floor, Keningau Mall, Keningau, Sabah. We open every day from 9:30 AM to 7:30 PM.
